channel.title: Egypt - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Egypt, every source cited.

item.title: Egypt moves to raise fines for false news
item.description: The government is preparing amendments to the Penal Code to increase penalties for spreading false information online.

item.title: Egypt eyes floating nuclear reactors with Russia
item.description: Cairo is discussing the deployment of floating and small modular nuclear reactors with Rosatom.

item.title: Suez Canal Authority seeks Greek maritime investment
item.description: Egypt's canal authority chairman met with Greece's ambassador to discuss trade and logistics cooperation.

item.title: Egypt's pensions fall short for 10.2 million elderly
item.description: Retirees say modest, unevenly distributed benefits do not cover living costs as the older population grows.

item.title: El-Sisi in Moscow for Russia-Africa Summit
item.description: Egypt and Russia will discuss economic cooperation, investment, and food security at the summit.
